html:
The skill tree window of the game for one tree: the combat skills, the passives and (a click on the eye) the Abyssal skills. Hover a skill to see its card, a passive to see its text. Everything is shown for a player of level 55.

Usage 

{{Skilltree|Sorcery}}
{{Skilltree|Sorcery|abyssal=yes}}
{{Skilltree|Sorcery|float=right}}

The boxes of the skills open to the right of the tree. In a tree on the right of the page (float=right) they open to the left; tips=left or tips=right sets it by hand. A box shows the skill with the rank of the game screenshots; its versions (Basic, Quake ...) and the skills of its chain can be switched inside the box. Needs

  • Module:Skilltree, Module:Skilltree/data, Template:Skilltree/styles.css (this template) and Template:Skill/styles.css, Module:Skill (the cards)
  • File:Ability_change.png (the eye icon is cut out of it)
  • The icons of the skills and of the passives (buff icons), uploaded like for Template:Tl

No description.
